import semver

# Test VersionInfo.isvalid
print("Testing VersionInfo.isvalid:")
print(f"  '1.2.3' -> {semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('1.2.3')}")
print(f"  '01.2.3' -> {semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('01.2.3')}")
print(f"  'not a version' -> {semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('not a version')}")
print(f"  '1.2' -> {semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('1.2')}")
print(f"  '' -> {semver.VersionInfo.isvalid('')}")

# Test cmd_check
print("\nTesting cmd_check:")
result = semver.cmd_check('1.2.3')
print(f"  cmd_check('1.2.3') -> {result}")
result = semver.cmd_check('invalid')
print(f"  cmd_check('invalid') -> {result}")

# Test cmd_bump
print("\nTesting cmd_bump:")
result = semver.cmd_bump('major', '1.2.3')
print(f"  cmd_bump('major', '1.2.3') -> {result}")

# Test cmd_compare
print("\nTesting cmd_compare:")
result = semver.cmd_compare('1.2.3', '2.0.0')
print(f"  cmd_compare('1.2.3', '2.0.0') -> {result}")
